links.to_node: I do not prevent my colleague from implementing the new power grid system.
The new power grid system is implemented by my colleague.
The city experiences a temporary shutdown of power supply due to the implementation.
Residents face a city-wide blackout for several days.
Energy consumption in the city is significantly reduced after implementation.
Energy taxes for residents are lowered.
The city gains a more stable and sustainable power supply for the future.
The city experiences a blackout caused by the major storm as predicted.
My colleague successfully completes the project despite the blackout.
